sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
sources.evidence: Dated May 28, 2026; announces availability that day, identifies the Opus 4.7 successor and API ID claude-opus-4-8, and describes coding and agentic work.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.8 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact model page lists May 28, 2026 release, 1M context, adaptive thinking, text/image inputs and text output; identifies current status as active legacy and lists hosted access platforms.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.8 System Card
sources.evidence: Original May 28 card, updated June 3, downloaded with curl after web size-limit failure and extracted with pdftotext. Section 1 identifies developer, agentic tool use, training process and text-only output; no production parameter counts or architectural specification found in text.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF with curl and extracted text. Later card compares against exact Opus 4.8 across evaluations but does not report its production parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF with curl and extracted text. Later card discusses Opus 4.8 comparisons and fallback behavior, but no total/active parameter count or architecture for Opus 4.8 was found.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF with curl and extracted text. Exact Opus 4.8 comparison entries concern evaluation scores and fallback behavior, not model size or architecture.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF with curl and extracted text. Reviewed later comparisons and parameter/architecture references; none disclose Opus 4.8 production parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: PDF support - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing. PDF pages are converted to images and extracted text; this supports retaining pdf as a supported input format alongside text/image.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is governed by commercial service terms; reverse engineering or duplicating the service is restricted and no intellectual-property rights are granted except as stated. Supports descriptive proprietary license classification.

sources.title: Prompting Claude Opus 4.8
sources.evidence: Exact-model guidance documents adaptive thinking, effort controls, tool use and long-horizon agentic capabilities.

sources.title: Would This Change Your Answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior in the Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
sources.evidence: First-party interpretability research names Opus 4.8 as a predictor agent. Its activation-tool discussion concerns target models and does not establish Opus 4.8 architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: Automated Researchers Can Mitigate Well-Characterized Alignment Failures
sources.evidence: First-party training research uses Opus 4.8 as an automated researcher. Sizes of models it trains are not Opus 4.8 specifications; no exact-model architecture disclosure was found.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Opus 4.8 record
sources.evidence: Followed baseline catalog link as a discovery lead; technical claims were checked against Anthropic sources.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: The September 29, 2026 article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or supplied to users; the same article names Opus 4.8 among evaluated Claude models. Used only for distribution status.

developer.note: Named developer in the original card.

family.note: Catalog slug for the official Claude Opus tier.

release_date.note: Announcement explicitly states available today; documentation gives the same date.

open_weights.note: Explicit general Claude nonpublic-weight policy and the article's named Opus 4.8 evaluation establish closed weights; hosted access alone is not the basis.

license.note: Descriptive service/model classification, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count found in original card or reviewed later exact-model comparisons. Do not substitute another model or interpretability feature count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count disclosed in the reviewed original/later cards; no dense-versus-MoE assumption is made.

architecture.note: Original/later cards and targeted first-party interpretability/training research did not establish exact-model architecture. Hybrid reasoning describes behavior, and SAE discussion does not establish dense/MoE topology.

modalities.note: Native text/image inputs and text output; PDF retained as supported document format processed into text/images, not a distinct native modality.

reasoning.note: Supports adaptive thinking; capability does not imply that thinking is enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Original card and exact-model prompting guidance document agentic tool use.

description.value: Claude Opus model with adaptive thinking for coding, tool use, and long-running agentic work.
description.note: Replaces stale comparative top-tier/hardest claims with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Claude Opus model with adaptive thinking for coding, tool use, and long-running agentic work.

sources.label: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities

patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts and production architecture are undisclosed in the reviewed original and later system cards. PDF inputs are processed as text and page images.

summary: Confirmed exact name, developer/family, May 28 release, closed hosted distribution, 1M context, text/image/PDF input, text output, adaptive reasoning and tool use. Add proprietary license and a neutral capability description with primary provenance. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed after original-card, four later-card comparison, and targeted first-party research review; no size or topology inferred.
